always_trade_baselines.interpretation: The frozen trade geometry is negative without selection in both directions. Any positive result must come from genuine ranking or selection rather than unconditional drift.

LONG_result.ridge: All policies fail Extreme cost or winner-concentration review and none provide stable fold-level evidence.
LONG_result.reason: Aggregate Strong values are near flat, Extreme cost is negative, and removing top winners makes every LONG policy negative.

SHORT_multinomial_logistic.interpretation: The SHORT classifier has useful tail-ranking evidence because all three policies are positive under Strong and Extreme cost, and the Standard and High-coverage policies remain positive after removing fold-level top five winners. However F2 is negative and F4 contributes more than 65 percent of positive-fold R, so the signal is regime-concentrated.

probability_and_regression_quality.interpretation: Raw logistic probabilities are not calibrated and Ridge does not improve point prediction. ML-04 scores may be used only as ranking evidence, not as calibrated probabilities or EV.

stable_feature_groups: M15 and H4 volatility or spread state
coefficient_stability.risk: Time-of-day coefficients are among the largest. ML-05 must verify that performance is not merely a narrow session proxy.

frozen_shadow_gate_check.SHORT_conservative: FAIL: fewer than three positive folds, negative Brier skill, and single-fold concentration above 50 percent
frozen_shadow_gate_check.SHORT_standard: FAIL: fewer than three positive folds, negative Brier skill, and single-fold concentration above 50 percent
frozen_shadow_gate_check.SHORT_high_coverage: FAIL: aggregate Strong PF below 1.20, maximum fold DD above 20R, negative Brier skill, and single-fold concentration above 50 percent

ml05_authorization_by_result.scope: Train and audit nonlinear tabular gradient-boosting models for both directions under the same frozen folds and policies. Treat LONG as a required negative-control lane and SHORT as the primary research lane.
